undo.definition:
v. cancel, annul, or reverse an action or its effect
v. cause the ruin or downfall of
undo.translation:
vt. 解开, 取消, 破坏, 毁灭, 扰乱
vi. 松开
[计] 撤消

undoable.translation: a. 不能做(或干)的,做(或干)不了的

undock.definition:
v. move out of a dock
v. take (a ship) out of a dock
undock.translation:
vt. 使出坞
vi. 出坞, 驶离码头

undocked.definition:
v move out of a dock
v take (a ship) out of a dock
undocked.translation: v. 使出坞, 驶离码头( undock的过去式和过去分词 )

undocking.definition:
v move out of a dock
v take (a ship) out of a dock
undocking.translation: v. 使出坞, 驶离码头( undock的现在分词 )

undocks.definition:
v move out of a dock
v take (a ship) out of a dock
undocks.translation: v. 使出坞, 驶离码头（undock的第三人称单数形式）

undocumented.definition: a. lacking necessary documents (as for e.g. permission to live or work in a country)
undocumented.translation: a. 无正式文件的, 无事实证明的

undoer.definition:
n. a seducer who ruins a woman
n. a person who unfastens or unwraps or opens
undoer.translation: n. 破坏者, 勾引者

undoers.definition:
plural of undoer
n. a seducer who ruins a woman
n. a person who unfastens or unwraps or opens
undoers.translation: (undoer 的复数) n. 破坏者, 勾引者

undoes.definition:
v cancel, annul, or reverse an action or its effect
v deprive of certain characteristics
v cause the ruin or downfall of
v cause to become loose
v remove the outer cover or wrapping of
undoes.translation: v. 松开( undo的第三人称单数 ); 解开; 毁灭; 败坏

undogmatic.definition: s unwilling to accept authority or dogma (especially in religion)
undogmatic.translation: a. 非教条的, 非武断的

undoing.definition: n. an act that makes a previous act of no effect (as if not done)

undomesticated.definition:
s. not domesticated
s. unaccustomed to home life
undomesticated.translation: a. 未驯服的, 不适应家庭生活的, 不喜欢家庭的, 不善于做家务的, 不爱做家务的

undone.definition:
s. not done
s. not fastened or tied or secured
undone.translation:
a. 没有做好, 未完成的, 破灭的, 解开的
undo的过去分词

undose.translation: a. 呈波浪形的,波状的

undosed.definition:
v cancel, annul, or reverse an action or its effect
v deprive of certain characteristics
v cause the ruin or downfall of
v cause to become loose
v remove the outer cover or wrapping of
undosed.translation: 未给剂量的, 未经照射的

undouble.definition: v. t. To unfold, or render single.
undouble.translation: v. (使)不再对折,(使)展开,(使)不再握紧,(使)松开

undoubled.translation: a. 不再对折的,展开的,不再握紧的,松开的

undoubted.definition:
a. Not doubted; not called in question; indubitable;
   indisputable; as, undoubted proof; undoubted hero.
undoubted.translation:
a. 无疑的, 确实的
[法] 无疑的, 确实的

undoubtedly.translation: adv. 无疑, 必定, 确实地

undoubting.translation: a. 信任的, 不怀疑的
